title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.
llm_summary: Sequoia Capital is ending its “Scouts” program, a pioneering model that let individual investors source early‑stage deals on the firm’s behalf—a blueprint many other VCs later copied. While the approach once helped surface promising startups, industry insiders now see its current structure as hitting a ceiling, prompting a shift toward new ways of sourcing and supporting deals.
